statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); git_branch=$(git -C "$dir" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); git_status=$(git -C "$dir" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then if [ "$git_status" -gt 0 ]; then git_info=" ($git_branch *)"; else git_info=" ($git_branch)"; fi; else git_info=""; fi; if [ -n "$used" ]; then ctx_info=" [ctx: ${used}%]"; else ctx_info=""; fi; printf "%s@%s:%s%s [%s]%s" "$(whoami)" "$(hostname -s)" "$(basename "$dir")" "$git_info" "$model" "$ctx_info"
